head: Google AI Mode: Gemini 4 Carbon now for AI Pro, model name gone
dek: Gemini 4 Carbon in Google Search's AI Mode, which had reached only AI Ultra subscribers less than a week earlier, now shows up for AI Pro subscribers too. The AI Mode bar has also stopped naming the model it's using.
details: Gagan Ghotra spotted both changes and Rajan Patel, Google's VP of Engineering for Search, confirmed them on 16 November: the Pro rollout is 'not a bug', and the missing label is intended, though Google is thinking about how to bring back a model indicator. Gemini 4 Hydrogen had already come to AI Mode for everyone. Countries and prices weren't given.
where: Google AI Pro and AI Ultra subscribers; countries not given
means: If you pay for Google AI Pro, AI Mode can now use Gemini 4 Carbon, but the bar won't tell you which model is answering.
todo: Open AI Mode in Google Search while signed in with your AI Pro account. Google hasn't said yet how you'll see which model is in use.
thumb_words: GEMINI 4 CARBON COMES TO AI PRO
